liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (4 reviews): Bobby’s guitar performance was described as particularly gorgeous and amazing; Considered one of the best performances of the year, with hot playing [13][14][15][16]
- **Saint of Circumstance** (3 reviews): Garcia played aggressively with licks as fast as in 1985, making it the highlight; Played with an energy reminiscent of the early 1980s [14][16][23]
- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): The song flowed great, fitting well in the second set; Foolish Heart and Stella Blue were especially strong performances [16][20]
- **Just Like Tom Thumb's Blues** (1 review): Played slower than the usual tempo [23]
- **Corina** (1 review): The reviewer likes the song but finds the lyrics stupid [22]

## The recordings

- **gd93-06-16.sbd.eliason.13330.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is excellent, though the reviewer recalls the live experience as mediocre; Drums are mixed great for headphone listening [13][23]
- **gd93-06-16.neumann.nawrocki.8192.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 152 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [5]. Said about its sound: Instruments are distinct with a nice round low end, better than the soundboard [21]
- **gd1993-06-16.nak300.footbear.99155.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 152 min [8]. Said about its sound: Subtle slap-back from PA at set start, dialed out after 45 seconds [8]
- **gd1993-06-16.110439.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 153 min [2]

## Around the show

- The band played Don't Ease Me In two nights in a row, needing practice [18]
- Freedom Hall shows were decent and featured a good crowd [18]
- Listeners stayed at the Days Inn in downtown Louisville during the run [21]
- The first set was forgettable, but the second set was described as magic [20]
- The two-day Louisville run features some of the best playing of 1993 [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-06-16.sbd.eliason.13330.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT>C>DAT>Samplitude>CD>EAC>SHN seeded by Tom Eliason [1]
- **gd93-06-16.neumann.nawrocki.8192.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Doug Nawrocki; source: Audience: Neumann TLM 170's [5]
- **gd1993-06-16.nak300.footbear.99155.flac16**: transferred by Footbear; source: 4 x Nak CM-300/CP-4's (3' spread @ 12' height) -> Sony TCD-D3 DAT @48k [8]
- **gd1993-06-16.110439.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; transferred by Terry Watts; source: Source: (Handheld/ORTF/110^/FOB/DFC/Row20) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > Panasonic SV-255 > DAT(m) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Freedom Hall](https://www.dead.net/archives/1993/clippings/backstage-pass-freedom-hall-0) [26]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1993-06-16 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1993-06-16-grateful-dead-ticket/) [27]
